$schema_note: The versioned schema for an MP-E12a association graph. v1 is the shape of the sealed synthetic calibration (experiments/MP-E12/results/probes_synthetic_calibration.json) and is NOT rewritten by this revision. v2 is the shape both paths emit now: every v1 field survives, and the fields marked added carry the two operation tallies, the source kind, the candidate-pool rule and, on real nodes, the address a figure came from. A validator is tools/mp_e12_validate_graph.py; there is no jsonschema package in this environment, so the checks are explicit and they are tested.

accounting_used.meaning: which of the two tallies the per-item budget was checked against. The real run uses conservative, which charges every journaled read call; the sealed calibration used registered, where a gather of already-read rows is free.

invariants: operations_spent <= budget when aborted is false
every entry in reads names a tensor and a probe_id
no entry in reads names a tensor matching ^h\.\d+\.attn\.bias$

item.meaning: a budget event. On the real source the plan is arithmetic on tensor shapes and NO read was issued, so an abort costs zero values and zero journal records.

accounting_tallies.note: all three numbers are emitted for every run so the ruling on the counting rule can be made with data rather than argument

energy_estimate.const: NOT MEASURED -- no energy instrument in this repository (D-MPE12-02)

added_by_v2.address: present on the real path only: tensor, row, col, byte_offset, bytes_of_one_value, dtype, struct_code, tensor_base_offset, shape. It is what lets the access journal answer 'which address, for which probe' for every claim in the artifact.

what_a_real_graph_is_not.latency_or_10x: no wall-clock ratio is emitted against the real donor; the threshold has never been re-based on these shapes
what_a_real_graph_is_not.behaviour: no text generated, no prompt run, the donor never executed, so R17 does not bind these figures and no fresh-vs-fresh floor is required for them
what_a_real_graph_is_not.global_reach: a real neighbour is nearest among the candidate pool, not among the vocabulary
what_a_real_graph_is_not.MP-E12b: barred by D-MPE12-04 and untouched here
